name: West Memphis data center
status_note: $4bn through 2027 (Google) on ~1,000 acres with a substation; start of construction marked Oct 2025; build expected to take up to two years. Google has not published a capacity.

construction_start.note: Officials mark the start of the $4bn AI data center (Route Fifty, Oct 2025).
